record.field: WITH aml_agg AS ( SELECT aml.partner_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM aml.date) AS year, SUM( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END ) AS sum_J, SUM( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN aml.debit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN aml.debit - aml.credit WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN aml.tax_base_amount ELSE 0 END ) AS sum_K FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT aammlcr.account_account_id AS account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id AS concept_id FROM account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr UNION ALL SELECT aaat.account_account_id AS account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids AS concept_id FROM mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat INNER JOIN account_account_tag aat ON aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids INNER JOIN account_account_account_tag aaat ON aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) AS aa ON aa.concept_id = mmlc.id LEFT JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id WHERE mm.id = {id} AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY aml.partner_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM aml.date) ) SELECT a.year AS "Vigencia", CASE WHEN it.l10n_co_edi_code IS NOT NULL THEN it.l10n_co_edi_code ELSE it.dian_code END AS "Tipo de documento", rp.vat AS "Número de documento de identificación", rp.name AS "Nombres y Apellidos o Razón Social", rp.street AS "Dirección de Notificación", rp.phone AS "Teléfono", rp.email AS "Email", rcsc.dian_code AS "Código ciudad o municipio (codificación DANE)", rcs.dian_code AS "Código Departamento (codificación DANE)", CASE WHEN mm.smaller_amount != 0.00 THEN CASE WHEN a.sum_J > mm.smaller_amount THEN a.sum_J ELSE NULL END ELSE a.sum_J END AS "Monto Pago sin IVA", CASE WHEN mm.smaller_amount != 0.00 THEN CASE WHEN a.sum_K > mm.smaller_amount THEN a.sum_K ELSE NULL END ELSE a.sum_K END AS "Monto Retención", COALESCE(MAX(t.amount), 0) AS "Tarifa" FROM aml_agg a LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = a.partner_id LEFT JOIN l10n_latam_identification_type it ON it.id = rp.l10n_latam_identification_type_id LEFT JOIN res_city rcsc ON rcsc.id = rp.city_id LEFT JOIN res_country_state rcs ON rcs.id = rp.state_id CROSS JOIN mag_media mm -- mm.id es fijo ({id}) LEFT JOIN account_tax_repartition_line atrl ON atrl.account_id = (SELECT aml.account_id FROM account_move_line aml LIMIT 1) AND atrl.repartition_type = 'tax' LEFT JOIN account_tax t ON t.id = atrl.invoice_tax_id OR t.id = atrl.refund_tax_id GROUP BY a.year, it.l10n_co_edi_code, it.dian_code, rp.vat, rp.name, rp.street, rp.phone, rp.email, rcsc.dian_code, rcs.dian_code, mm.smaller_amount, a.sum_J, a.sum_K HAVING (mm.smaller_amount = 0) OR (mm.smaller_amount != 0 AND a.sum_K > mm.smaller_amount);
